experience.description: Lead a cross-functional team of 8+ across Adobe Commerce Cloud and Enterprise implementations. Introduced AI-assisted development and code-review workflows, architect headless commerce solutions, own technical estimation, and establish code-quality governance.

Built custom enterprise Adobe Commerce modules, engineered bi-directional Jitterbit and Salesforce integration, developed an Adobe App Builder Odoo connector published on Adobe Exchange, delivered Hyvä storefronts, and optimized production performance and delivery pipelines.
Developed Magento 2 modules, themes and extensions; integrated payment, shipping and tax services; diagnosed production performance issues; supported Magento 1-to-2 migrations and release validation.
Built custom Magento modules and storefront features, contributed Magento–Odoo synchronization, resolved production issues, and collaborated on responsive storefront themes.
